text:
Alex P: Heads up — ACME reported 3 on-prem nodes in their VPC going into OOM/kernel panic after yesterday's scheduled kernel update (5.15.0-101 -> 5.15.0-102). They run nvidia-driver 525.89.02. They say the pods crash with nvml errors.
Maria G: Hmm, 525.89.02 is built against older kernel headers; we list 525.x as supported for 5.15.0-100 but 5.15.0-102 has ABI changes. Did we update our supported matrix? @Chris L do we have a compatibility note?
Chris L: I don't think we published 5.15.0-102 in the private matrix. Matrix shows up to 5.15.0-100 for on-prem. Customer probably auto-upgraded kernel. 
Sylvia R: On the customer side we saw `dmesg` with `nvidia: nvidia: probe failed with error -22` and `nvlink: could not bind`. That's classic ABI mismatch. Also saw `cudart` logs complaining about corrupted page tables.
Alex P: Customer is pushing back — they're on a managed kernel cadence and can't hold upgrades. They want us to support 5.15.0-102 or provide a hotfix. Options?
Dan K: Short term: advise rollback or install `nvidia-driver` compiled for 5.15.0-102. Long term: add kernel ABI checks into our deploy agent and warn customers via Console when kernel drift is detected.
Maria G: Could we ship an agent check quickly? Maybe `modinfo nvidia | grep vermagic` and compare to kernel `uname -r` to detect mismatch and emit an alert.
Chris L: Also need to confirm NCCL/kernel module compatibility. If modules load but kernel symbols differ we'll get silent corruption. @sre-bot can you pull the node logs and attach the last 200 lines?
sre-bot: logs attached (s3://redwood-eng/logs/acme-edge/nodes/172.31.5.12/last-200.txt) — forwarded to eng-infra. 
Sylvia R: I looked — there's also a subtle zswap config they enabled, might expose a race with older nvidia module. Not common but possible.
Alex P: OK steps: (1) ask CS to advise rollback to 5.15.0-100 or install correct driver; (2) we add an agent patch to detect vermagic mismatch and flag in Console ASAP; (3) add 5.15.0-102 to 'unsupported but observed' list and run regression in staging with 525.89.02. Chris/Dan own 2/3.
Chris L: I'll take the staging regression + kernel repro tests. Dan take the agent check. Maria can you coordinate with CS for rollback guidance.
Maria G: On it — pinging CS and adding a KB with `modinfo` commands and rollback steps. 
Alex P: Thanks. If anyone sees this customer escalate, inbox me. :pray:
